sentences.en: Her slurred speech was an indication that she was drunk.
sentences.zh: 她的口齿不清表明她喝醉了。

sentences.en: The cursing tongue is an indication of a bad heart.
sentences.zh: 恶毒的语言是心地恶劣的表现。

sentences.en: A slanderous tongue is an indication of a bad heart.
sentences.zh: 恶毒的语言是心地恶劣的表现。

senses.zh: 迹象，表示；标示，指示；暗示，暗示性的东西

mnemonic: 词根记忆：in（加以…）+dic（说）+ation（行为）→说出→指示
